data: Un rockeur trop sentimental, une jeune femme indécise, un vieux père fantasque. Dans la petite ville de Tonnerre, les joies de l’amour ne durent qu’un temps. Une disparition aussi soudaine qu’inexpliquée et voici que la passion cède place à l’obsession… (A rocker who's too sentimental, a young who's indecisive, an elderly, whimsical father. In the small town of Tonnerre, the joys of love never last long. Then a disappearance as sudden as it is unexpected makes passion give way to obsession.)

A rocker who's too sentimental, a young who's indecisive, an elderly, whimsical father. In the small town of Tonnerre, the joys of love never last long. Then a disappearance as sudden as it is unexpected makes passion give way to obsession.
